commands: ^[Ee]xit before auth from \<?<ADDR>:\d+\>?: (?:\([^\)]*\): )?Max auth tries reached - user '<F-USER>.+</F-USER>'\s*$
^[Ee]xit before auth \(user '.+', \d+ fails\): Max auth tries reached - user '<F-USER>.+</F-USER>' from <HOST>:\d+\s*$

nft add table inet f2b-table
nft -- add chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain \{ type filter hook input priority -1 \; \}
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo 'ssh' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo 'ssh' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi

{ nft flush set inet f2b-table <addr_set> 2> /dev/null; } || {
{ nft -a list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | sed -nE 's/.*@<addr_set>\s+.*\s+\#\s*(handle\s+[0-9]+)$/\1/p'; } | while read -r hdl; do
nft delete rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $hdl; done
nft delete set inet f2b-table <addr_set>
nft add set inet f2b-table <addr_set> \{ type <addr_type>\;<sp>flags interval\; \}
if [ 'tcp' != "all" ]; then
for proto in $(echo 'tcp' | sed 's/,/ /g'); do
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain $proto dport \{ $(echo 'ssh' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
done
else
nft add rule inet f2b-table f2b-chain th dport \{ $(echo 'ssh' | sed s/:/-/g) \} <addr_family> saddr @<addr_set> reject
fi
}
nft list chain inet f2b-table f2b-chain | grep -q '@<addr_set>[ \t]'

[DEFAULT]
usedns = no
mta = mail

[dropbear]
enabled = true
backend = auto
logpath = /dev/null
maxretry = 1
bantime = 600
